title: Flatten and unflatten nested settings
prompt:
The settings UI stores nested JSON as flat keys. Implement in app/flat.py `flatten(obj)` — nested dicts become
dotted keys (`{"db": {"host": "x"}}` → `{"db.host": "x"}`) and lists use the index (`{"tags": ["a"]}` →
`{"tags.0": "a"}`); empty dicts and lists are kept as values — and `unflatten(flat)`, its inverse (numeric segments
build lists). `unflatten(flatten(x)) == x` for any JSON-like value whose dict keys contain no dots.
